post.summary: Update current Work Order status based on FOMS Process
post.description:
This endpoint is used to update operation process start/end information. So ERPNext can initiate job card, stock entry, start, and end job card logic based on the provided data. Completion of job card logic depends on FOMS's operation process start and end statuses.
Set percentage to 100 to complete the Operation

404.description: Item not found or invalid input

get.summary: Retrieve Batch details and associated Stock Transactions by external Lot ID
get.description: Fetches details of a specific Batch using its external 'foms_lot_id', and retrieves the 10 most recent associated Stock Ledger Entries. For each ledger entry, it fetches the full document details (e.g., Delivery Note, Purchase Receipt).

parameters.name: lotid
parameters.description: The external FOMS Lot ID to search for.

items.description: Full document details of associated transactions (e.g., Delivery Note, Stock Entry).

404.description: Lot ID not found or no associated transactions found.

get.summary: Retrieve Delivery Note details by Lot IDs
get.description: Fetches Batch info and Delivery Notes. Note: 'lotid' parameter must be a JSON formatted string array.

parameters.name: lotid
parameters.description: A JSON string array of Lot IDs. Example: ["LOT-001", "LOT-002"]

400.description: Invalid JSON format in lotid parameter

post.summary: Update package size for work order
post.description: Update the packaging size for a work order based on Lot ID. Changes the packet size, conversion factor, and required packaging item quantities.

lotID.description: The FOMS Lot ID of the work order

404.description: Work Order not found or Packaging Size not found

get.description: Retrieve all in-progress Purchase Orders for a specific item and company. Returns order details including quantities, schedule dates, and status.

parameters.name: item_code
parameters.description: The item code to search for in Purchase Orders

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: The company name to filter Purchase Orders

status.description: Current status of the Purchase Order

transaction_date.description: Date when the PO was created

required_date.description: Expected delivery date for this item

post.description: Receive forecast data from external server and create/update Request documents. Maps custom names to ERP master data via Forecast Settings, then creates or updates Request documents with the mapped data. Duplicate detection: Request level (proposed_customer + delivery_date), Item level (item_code - qty replaced if exists).

veg_name.description: Custom name for item (mapped via Forecast Settings)

uom_in_kg.description: Package weight in Kg to match in Packaging List Available

customer.description: Custom name for customer (mapped via Forecast Settings)

400.description: Invalid payload or Forecast Settings not enabled

post.summary: Get Lead Time by Custom Names
post.description: Get lead time for items by custom names from Forecast Settings. Maps custom names to item codes, then retrieves lead_time_days from Item master. Returns min/max lead time and detail per custom name.

requestBody.description: Array of veg names to lookup

veg_names.description: JSON string array of veg names

min_lead_time.description: The lowest lead time in days

max_lead_time.description: The highest lead time in days

detail.description: Lead time per custom name (null if not found)

post.description: Get item price from Item Price master. Use is_selling to choose between Standard Selling (1) or Standard Buying (0) price list.

is_selling.description: 1 for selling price (Standard Selling), 0 for buying price (Standard Buying). Default: 1

customer.description: Customer name or custom name from Forecast Settings (e.g. 'NTUC' maps to 'NTUC Fairprice Co-Operative Limited'). Optional.

400.description: Invalid input or item not found

post.summary: Get UOM Conversion Factor for Item
post.description: Get the conversion factor between a specified UOM and the item's stock UOM.

conversion_factor.description: Conversion factor from specified UOM to stock UOM

400.description: Invalid input or UOM not found

post.description: Get stock UOM and all available UOMs with conversion factors for an item. Supports custom names from Forecast Settings (e.g. 'Kai Lan' maps to 'PR-AV-KL').

item_code.description: Item code or custom name from Forecast Settings (mandatory)

stock_uom.description: Base stock UOM of the item

uoms.description: List of available UOMs with conversion factors

400.description: Invalid input or item not found
